culprit_citations.quoted_text: Ratios of net investment income (loss) to average net assets | 8.5
Period from Initial Share Issuance to December 31, 2025 | NAV Per Share

findings.detail: Distribution rate appears annualized from the aggregate period distribution per share as if it were a one-month amount; source period distributions of 0.81 per share over initial share issuance to year end imply about 7.9% annualized against NAV, below 1.5 times the 8.5% NII yield.

rationale: F16 failed with value 4.744545, implying an observed distribution rate of about 40.33% against the source NII yield of 8.5%. Raw source financial highlights show distributions of 0.81 per share for the period from initial share issuance to December 31, 2025 and an ending NAV of 24.64, which is about 3.29% for the period or about 7.9% annualized over roughly five months. The same table reports NII yield to average net assets of 8.5%, so the source does not support a distribution rate exceeding 1.5 times income yield. The defect is localized to distribution-rate scaling/annualization, not to the source economics.
